definitions: A willingness to temporarily set aside one's critical faculties and believe the unbelievable; to sacrifice realism and logic for the sake of enjoyment.
The intentional avoidance of logical scrutiny or critical judgment in order to appreciate a work of fiction or fantasy.
examples: The film required a significant suspension of disbelief.
For the magic trick to work, a suspension of disbelief was essential.
Children often have an easier time with suspension of disbelief.
